technical.summary: ACN shows long-term uptrend structure but is caught in a sharp short-term downtrend with multiple oversold indicators lacking bullish confirmation—high risk of further downside before reversal.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 57 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Moderate congressional buying (2 purchases vs 1 sale, largest $100K-$250K) combined with market fear (31 Fear/Greed score) and neutral AAII sentiment suggests contrarian buy opportunity, though lack of recent news data limits conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (325.76) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 57 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA/SMA structure remains bullish, congressional buying conviction is present, and extreme VIX/fear conditions create contrarian opportunity near support (323.34) with 57-day earnings catalyst ahead.
debate.key_bear_argument: Multiple oversold indicators (RSI, Stoch, Williams %R) show zero bullish confirmation, MACD bearish crossover, price below all key moving averages, negative CMF/OBV, no insider conviction, and macro environment unfavourable—setup lacks the reversal confirmation needed to justify entry in crisis VIX regime.

decision.entry_rationale: Congressional buying and extreme fear conditions create contrarian appeal, but lack of bullish confirmation across momentum indicators (RSI, MACD, Stoch, OBV) and zero insider conviction make entry premature.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (325.76) combined with price below all key moving averages and negative CMF creates risk of further downside before any reversal materializes; earnings in 57 days add event uncertainty.
